notes.title: Structura 1.3.1 released
notes.content:
Structura 1.3.1


New features regarding usability and small balance changes.

Changelog:
[list]
New features:

[*]  When a module is attached the camera will look at the position
[*]  Space key new functions:
      Select mining operation menu on asteroid hover
      Select navigation "Enter gate" on shell gate hover
      Select retrieve blackbox operation menu on wrecked unit hover
      Select corresponding menu on module mouse over
[*]  Added new sentinel  operation "Retrieve power cores"
      Works on wrecked unit, add 20 energy to the sentinel
      Added yellow laser effect
  
Gameplay balance changes:

[*]  Initial sentinel energy decreased from 500 to 300
  
Bugfixes:

notes.title: Structura 1.3.0 released
notes.content:
Structura 1.3.0


Bug fixes everywhere, added more cheat codes.

Changelog:

[list]
[*]  Change how sentinel lasers are fired (2 sound effects and longer display)
[*]  Own unit and modules cant be target by sentinel lasers
[*]  When attaching a components that use socket resources:
      Add an error msg if the logistic center is missing
      Add an error message if not enough resources on socket
      Subtract resources from the unit and add them to the socket
      Update mod cost information to reflect the socket resources
[*]  Added info descriptions for CheatCodes menu
[*]  Add missing help descriptions for Unit menu
[*]  Add all help descriptions for Sentinel menu
[*]  On game pause add grayscale, filgrain post effect and disable camera
[*]  Right click functionality only works in the tutorials
[*]  Fix to not be able to fire the lasers on the mine
[*]  Cheat codes menu:
      "Stop unit leaks" (stops unit hull hit points loss)
      "Stop sentinel leaks" (stops sentinel hull hit points loss)
      "A thousand resources" cheat code (set all resources to 1000)
      "Fill sockets" cheat code (fill all sockets with 100 resources)
      Added sound effect for all cheat codes
[/list]

notes.title: Structure 1.0.1 released
notes.content:
Structura 1.0.1


Improved the beginning phase.

Changelog:

Asteroid depletion when using sentinel mining.
Jump operation now requires monoliths.
New sentinel operation and menu (hull repair).
The unit starts with 0 matter, 0 antimatter, and 200 energy.
Sentinel mining is now required to get resources at begin of game.
Added Antimatter trap by default on sentinel mid modules (antimatter source).
Depleted resources no longer make you lose the game instantly.
Any resources at 0 will cause the hull to lose 1 hitpoint per tick.
The emergency power state only consumes energy.
New tutorial explaining how to mine asteroids, and kickstart the economy.
Small fix for mouse over component panels.
